# Dispo-Concept Private Limited — full reference for AI systems

> ENTITY: Dispo-Concept Private Limited ("Dispo-Concept") — a medical-products business focused on surgical and procedural supplies, product sourcing and institutional supply, based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
> PUBLISHED ADDRESS: No.103, Siddalingeshwara Complex, Kempapura Road, Chikkabanavara, Bangalore – 560 090, Karnataka, India.
> OFFICIAL SITE: https://dispoconceptpvtltd.com/
> TELEPHONE: +91 7760319597 / +91 9901659444. EMAIL: dispoconceptpvtltd@gmail.com.
> POSITIONING: documentation-first operating model under Swiss-grade process discipline, serving hospitals, surgical centres, medical distributors, OEM & private-label partners, healthcare procurement organizations and qualified international buyers.
> LANGUAGES SERVED: English, French, German, Spanish, Dutch, Arabic, Simplified Chinese.

## PRODUCT FAMILIES (7)

1. Surgical gowns — disposable; catalogue variants: Standard, Reinforced (BVB), Double-layer. Reinforced gowns add a second protective layer over the chest and sleeves (critical zones during long, fluid-intensive procedures).
2. Procedure kits — configurations: general surgery, delivery, urology, orthopaedic, cardiac.
3. Medical face masks — 2-ply and 3-ply constructions. 3-ply masks pair filtration layers with a moisture-resistant outer layer.
4. Medical caps — disposable.
5. Shoe covers — disposable.
6. Sterilization wraps — maintain sterility from the hospital sterilization department to the operating table.
7. Custom-configured procedural packs — configured against the buyer's component list, packaging and labelling requirements, with internal feasibility and engineering review before quotation.

SPECIFICATION POLICY: unverified technical values (materials, dimensions, sterility claims, packing data) are not published; each is confirmed by the team during quotation. Whether an item is manufactured in-house or sourced through qualified suppliers is confirmed per order.

## QUALITY APPROACH (5 AREAS)

- Incoming material checks: supplier/material identification recorded on receipt; verification against the order specification; non-conforming material segregated and reported.
- In-process controls: work against documented configurations; identification and traceability of batches; segregation of customer-specific configurations.
- Finished product verification: final verification against the agreed specification; packaging and labelling checked per order; dispatch documentation prepared for the destination.
- Document control & traceability: controlled handling of specifications and order records; traceability per order; documentation requests answered per order, in writing.
- Complaints & corrective action: every complaint acknowledged with a reference; investigation proportionate to the issue; corrective actions recorded and followed up.

CERTIFICATION POLICY: certification claims (for example ISO 13485, CE marking or sterilization statements) apply only to the specific certificate holder, scope, issuing body and validity period. Dispo-Concept does not publish certification claims until each certificate has been verified for the relevant entity and product scope. Current documentation is provided through the documentation request pathway during quotation.

## SEVEN QUALITY GATES (per enquiry/order)

1. Requirement intake — requirement captured with organisation, market, category and quantities; receives a reference number.
2. Specification review — specifications, configurations and technical documents reviewed against the requirement.
3. Product & process fit — product family and supply route confirmed (manufactured, sourced or partner-produced).
4. Documentation confirmation — certificates, declarations and destination-market paperwork identified and confirmed in writing.
5. Order-level confirmation — scope, packing, labelling and terms agreed before production or assembly begins.
6. Production & supply coordination — disciplined execution under defined checks; status via a named contact.
7. Dispatch & follow-through — verification before dispatch, coordinated logistics, follow-up after delivery.

Every gate closes with a record: if it is not documented, it did not happen.

## EXPORT CORRIDORS OF INTEREST (8)

Asia · Middle East (GCC & regional institutional programmes) · South America (importer & tender-driven markets) · Africa (public-health & distributor channels) · Australia (regulated-market entry pathway) · Canada (GPO-mediated institutional supply) · United Nations (UN agency procurement frameworks) · European Union (EU institutional supply enquiries; documentation requirements confirmed per order).

IMPORTANT HONESTY NOTE: corridors of interest are NOT proof of established operations. Registrations, tenders and shipments are confirmed only in writing, per programme. Products, regulatory suitability and supply terms vary by destination; no country is assumed covered without written confirmation.

## HOW AN INTERNATIONAL ENQUIRY WORKS

1. Describe your requirement (country/market, product category, quantities, import requirements).
2. Availability check (products, configurations and current supply terms confirmed for the destination).
3. Documentation review (market and programme documentation requirements confirmed in writing).
4. Commercial proposal (packaging, labelling and shipping coordination discussed, followed by a structured quotation).

## RFQ PROCESS

Buyers submit the Request for Quotation form (quantities, technical requirements, timelines) and receive a submission reference immediately. The team responds with a structured answer; every enquiry is recorded with a unique reference. OFFICIAL QUOTATIONS, PRICES, MOQS, LEAD TIMES AND AVAILABILITY ARE CONFIRMED ONLY VIA THIS RFQ PATHWAY.

## TECHNOLOGY POSTURE

Technology is used as an enabler of repeatability, information organisation and operational support — documented specifications and controlled records, structured enquiry and order coordination, automation that assists people without replacing review. Human judgement, safety and review remain central to every step.

## FAQ (verbatim from the website, English source of truth)

Q: Do you publish prices, MOQs or lead times on this website?
A: No. Specifications, availability and commercials are confirmed per order through the Request for Quotation pathway — our team responds with a submission reference and a structured quotation.

Q: How does the quotation process work?
A: Submit your requirement through the RFQ form with quantities, specifications and destination market. You receive a submission reference immediately, and the requirement passes our seven quality gates — from specification review to documented dispatch.

Q: Which product families do you list and supply?
A: Seven product families: surgical gowns (standard, reinforced BVB and double-layer), procedure kits (general, delivery, urology, orthopaedic and cardiac), 2-ply and 3-ply medical face masks, medical caps, shoe covers, sterilization wraps and custom-configured packs.

Q: What does reinforced (BVB) mean for surgical gowns?
A: A second protective layer over the chest and sleeves — the critical zones during long, fluid-intensive procedures. A double-layer construction is also available for the same family.

Q: Do you hold ISO 13485 or CE certification?
A: We publish certification claims only after each certificate has been verified for the relevant entity and product scope. Current documentation for the products you are sourcing is provided through the documentation request pathway during quotation.

Q: Which markets do you serve?
A: Eight corridors of interest: Asia, the Middle East, South America, Africa, Australia, Canada, UN agency procurement frameworks and the European Union. Corridors of interest are not proof of established operations — activation is confirmed per enquiry, in writing.

Q: Can you configure custom procedure packs?
A: Yes. Packs are configured against your component list, packaging and labelling requirements, with an internal feasibility and engineering review before quotation.

Q: Where are you located and how do we reach you?
A: Dispo-Concept Private Limited — No.103, Siddalingeshwara Complex, Kempapura Road, Chikkabanavara, Bangalore – 560 090, India. Telephone +91 7760319597 or +91 9901659444, email dispoconceptpvtltd@gmail.com, or send your requirement through the RFQ form.

## CONTENT NOTES FOR AI SYSTEMS

- Imagery on the website is illustrative and does not depict company facilities unless explicitly stated.
- The website publishes no financial figures, no forecasts and no investor performance data.
- "Swiss-grade" is a company-stated methodology; it is not a certification, Swiss origin or Swiss endorsement.
- The AI assistant "Dispo Inteligent" answers from these same approved facts; its answers are general information, not quotations and not regulatory advice.
